resolution: Fixed the editor-wide crash when opening certain prop thumbnails. Root cause: 7 potted-plant recipes (plantCactus, plantCactusLarge, plantFicus, plantMonstera, plantPalm, plantSucculent, planterBox) gave their 'leavesC' sphere color: COLORS.leafDark, but each palette only defined pot/soil/leaf/leafLight — leafDark was undefined, so cssColor read undefined[0] and threw a TypeError that the GlobalErrorBoundary caught, blanking every prop tile. TS would have flagged the missing key but esbuild does not typecheck. Real fix: added the intended leafDark shade (a darker tone of each plant's leaf) to all 7 palettes; verified by resolving every one of the 433 prop kinds' parts — 0 now have a missing color (was 7), via a throwaway checker since deleted. Defense in depth so one bad recipe can never take down the editor again: cssColor now falls back to a neutral tan instead of throwing, and dataPropParts logs the offending kind+part by name. Hot-reloads in rjit dev (TSX only, no rebuild).
